comparison_kind: read-only HTML infrastructure and raw-link evidence; no browser baseline comparison by this task
interpretation: The shared generated Quarto handler recognizes the published site URL, localhost and mailto. The required 127.0.0.1 origin is not included. It adorns non-navigation links with target=_blank and rel=noopener. This is evidence of the page runtime mechanism, not browser injection. Failed ordinary link activation remains pending independent runtime classification.
